result.summary: Found 1 issue: a major stuck loading indicator obscuring content in the Popular section.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is displayed in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image in the 'Popular right now' section, obscuring the already-visible food image and suggesting the card is stuck in a loading state.
issues.suggestion: Remove the loading overlay once the image/content has loaded. If loading is genuinely incomplete or failed, resolve the loading request or replace the spinner with a proper loaded state or an error/retry state.
